headline.purpose: The page h1 and auth card titles.

body.purpose: Tables, forms, Discussion, menus: almost everything.

label.purpose: Badges, metadata, live indicator, small buttons.

reference.purpose: Case references, fingerprints, Observable values, keys.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and press on buttons, badges and inputs (Tailwind transition default).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a view; one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); outline: none; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 0.8); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Destructive actions: red text on a 10% red tint, never a solid fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 280px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; outline: none; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Severity Badges
components.description: Severity by weight: Critical solid, High heavy outline, the rest thin outline.
components.html: Critical High Medium
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 500 0.75rem/1rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-badge-critical { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-badge-high { border: 2px solid oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-outline { border-color: oklch(0.922 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

components.name: Internal Badge
components.description: Marks items hidden from the Case's Guests.
components.css: .ds-badge-internal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px dashed oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.5); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 500 0.75rem/1rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat container with a hairline ring.
components.html:
Case Summary

Phishing email reported by Finance; two recipients clicked the link.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font: 500 1rem/1.5rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); }

components.name: Amber Notice
components.description: The one warning treatment, inline next to what it is about.
components.html: 2 Alerts changed since you saw them and were not attached. The rest were.
components.css: .ds-notice { width: 420px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.879 0.169 91.605); background: oklch(0.987 0.022 95.277); color: oklch(0.279 0.077 45.635); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Live Indicator
components.description: Connection state: a dot plus words.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 400 0.75rem/1rem 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-live-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.723 0.219 149.579); }

narrative.overview:
Argus is a working tool that Analysts keep open all day, and the design stays out of their way. Surfaces are white and neutral grey, text is near-black, and the only things that stand out are those that need attention: a warning, an error, an overdue Task, the live connection, and the people on the Case with you. Density is high. Body text is 14px, controls are 32px tall, and the standard gap is 8px, so a Case, its Tasks and its Alerts fit on one desktop screen without scrolling around.

The system is shadcn/ui ("radix-nova" style, neutral base colour) kept close to stock on purpose. Buttons, inputs, menus, dialogs, tables and the sidebar behave the way people expect from any modern web app, and no part of the interface needs learning. Argus's own character shows in a few domain markers: Severity shown by badge weight, the dashed "Internal" badge, monospace Case references, the live-status dot and tinted presence avatars.

The app is light mode only. Dark tokens exist in `src/index.css` (shadcn's defaults), but nothing switches to them.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral greyscale surfaces; colour appears only where something needs attention.
Stock shadcn/ui components with no custom styling of their own.
Flat: hairline borders and rings rather than shadows.
Domain meaning carried by weight, outline and pattern (solid, heavy, dashed) as well as colour.

rules.name: The Attention Rule
rules.body: Colour is used where it draws attention to something the person should notice: a warning, an error, something overdue, a connection state, another person. It is never decoration, and a neutral surface is the default.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Every warning uses the same Amber Notice treatment (amber-300 border, amber-50 fill, amber-950 text). Don't invent a second warning style.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: Working screens are set almost entirely in 14px body and 12px label. Larger sizes are for the page heading only.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Anything a person might copy, compare or search for exactly (references, hashes, IPs, keys) is set in monospace.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is floating above the page". Content in the page flow never gets one.

dos: Do use stock shadcn/ui components and add new ones with `bunx shadcn@latest add`.
Do keep working screens at 14px body and 12px label, with 32px controls and 8px gaps.
Do use colour only to draw attention (warnings, errors, overdue, live state, people), and use the existing signal colour for that meaning.
Do put every warning in the Amber Notice style, inline next to what it is about.
Do set references, hashes, IPs and keys in monospace.
Do pair every colour signal with words or a shape (a label, a dashed or heavy outline) so it never relies on colour alone.
donts: Don't restyle shadcn/ui components locally or add custom variants for one screen.
Don't put shadows on content in the page flow; they are only for menus, popovers, toasts and dialogs.
Don't use colour as decoration, such as tinted page backgrounds, gradients or coloured section headings.
Don't use a solid red fill for destructive buttons; use the red-tint destructive variant.
Don't create a second warning style next to Amber Notice.
